testCases.query: Enqueue an RQ job from a Python API without blocking the request
expectedBehavior: Uses an explicit Redis connection and named Queue
Passes an importable function or dotted function reference with small explicit arguments
Returns a stable job ID instead of waiting for the result
Separates job_timeout, ttl, result_ttl, and failure_ttl

testCases.query: Configure an RQ queue safely for JSON-compatible job arguments
expectedBehavior: Uses serializer=json on both Queue and Worker
Uses only JSON primitive argument types
Does not process untrusted Redis/job data with pickle
Keeps credentials out of job metadata, descriptions, results, and logs

testCases.query: Run RQ workers with queue priority and graceful shutdown
expectedBehavior: Recognizes that a standard worker processes one job at a time
Preserves queue order or explicitly selects round_robin/random dequeue behavior
Runs workers under a process manager in production
Lets SIGTERM finish the current job and registers worker death

testCases.query: Review a custom asyncio consumer built on RQ
expectedBehavior: Stops dequeuing before draining active tasks
Handles DequeueTimeout as an empty poll
Maintains job heartbeats independently of application work
Finalizes RQ state, cancels heartbeat tasks, and registers death in finally

testCases.query: Configure bounded retries for transient RQ failures
expectedBehavior: Uses Retry with an explicit maximum and bounded interval
Requires idempotency before retrying side effects
Enables the scheduler for delayed retry intervals
Keeps permanent failures distinguishable in FailedJobRegistry

testCases.query: Schedule an RQ job and inspect its scheduled state
expectedBehavior: Uses enqueue_at or enqueue_in
Runs a worker with the scheduler enabled
Recognizes ScheduledJobRegistry until the job is due
Protects programmatic scheduler startup with if __name__ == __main__

testCases.query: Cancel a queued RQ job or stop an active job
expectedBehavior: Uses job.cancel for queued work
Uses send_stop_job_command for active work
Does not claim that stopped jobs are automatically retried
Checks CanceledJobRegistry or FailedJobRegistry respectively

testCases.query: Add RQ status, registry, result, heartbeat, and test coverage
expectedBehavior: Uses get_status, get_meta, latest_result/results, and registry inspection
Uses Worker.count and heartbeats as liveness signals
Stores large outputs outside Redis
Uses SimpleWorker or Queue(is_async=False) for deterministic tests
